name: resilience engineering
rules: Give external calls, storage, workers and long-running operations explicit bounded timeouts and cancellation.
Retry only safe, transient, idempotent work within observable attempt and elapsed-time budgets.
Keep partial failure, cleanup failure, degraded state, retry provenance and sanitized diagnostics explicit.
verification: Review timeout, retry, idempotency, cleanup, health and degradation behavior for the affected operation.
Test transient, permanent, repeated, cancelled and partially completed failure paths.
